translation.title: Crotamiton Ointment
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for itchy skin (pruritus).
translation.usage: After a light bath, apply it once a day to the whole body of well-dried skin, excluding the face and scalp, and massage it in gently. If needed, repeat after 24 hours.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are or have been hypersensitive to it, or if you have acute lupus dermatitis. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are or have been hypersensitive to propylene glycol, if you are pregnant or may be pregnant, if you are breastfeeding, for infants and children, or if you are elderly. For suppurative (pus-forming) dermatitis, moist (weeping) areas or erosions (raw skin), treat these first before using this medicine. Do not use this medicine in the eyes (not for ophthalmic use). Adverse reactions may occur - hypersensitivity symptoms such as skin irritation, and a feeling of heat, a burning sensation, redness, erythema (red patches), increased secretions, infiltration and allergic contact reactions; if any of these occur, stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store at room temperature and keep out of reach of children.
